name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 V4
readme: Kendo Studio V4: MiniMax H3 generation plus a separate Upscale page using LTX 2.5 Refine Details/Tiled Fusion. Select a completed clip or a file from the generated-files page, or upload MP4/MOV/WebM. Aspect ratio is read from the source. 1080p/4K output keeps source frame count/fps/audio; no before/after comparison. Use a separate V4 persistent volume (200 GB). Accept Lightricks model access on Hugging Face and set HF_TOKEN in the Pod environment before first download. Services: Page 3000, MCP 3001, ComfyUI 8188, JupyterLab 8888. This configuration requires publishing the V4 image before launching.
